Two stats that the main text reports in running prose:

1. **Compartment × trip interaction (LMM)** — Shannon $\sim$ compartment $\times$ trip $+$ (1|site), fit with REML; omnibus Wald test across all interaction terms.
2. **Rhizosphere-Shannon × host-plant-genus ANOVA** — one-way ANOVA with host-plant-genus (iNaturalist-matched) as the grouping factor.

Both produce the exact $p$-values quoted in main-text Results.

```{python}
#| label: setup
import numpy as np, pandas as pd
from pathlib import Path
from scipy.stats import f_oneway, kruskal
import statsmodels.formula.api as smf
import warnings; warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")
REPO = Path("..").resolve()
CACHE = REPO / "cache"
```

```{python}
#| label: load
ft = pd.read_parquet(CACHE / "feature_table.parquet")
meta = pd.read_parquet(CACHE / "metadata.parquet")
def shannon(col):
    p = col[col>0]; p = p / p.sum()
    return float(-(p * np.log(p)).sum())
sh = ft.apply(shannon, axis=0).rename("Shannon")
df = meta.join(sh).reset_index()
print(f"samples: {len(df)}")
```

## 1. LMM: compartment × trip interaction

```{python}
#| label: lmm
df["compartment"] = df["compartment"].astype("category")
df["trip"] = df["trip"].astype("category")
df["site_str"] = df["site"].astype(str)

fit = smf.mixedlm("Shannon ~ C(compartment) * C(trip)", df, groups=df["site_str"]).fit(reml=True, method="lbfgs")

interaction_params = [p for p in fit.params.index if ":" in p]
wald = fit.wald_test(interaction_params, scalar=False)
stat = float(np.asarray(wald.statistic).item() if np.asarray(wald.statistic).size == 1 else np.asarray(wald.statistic).ravel()[0])
pv = float(np.asarray(wald.pvalue).item() if np.asarray(wald.pvalue).size == 1 else np.asarray(wald.pvalue).ravel()[0])
print(f"Omnibus Wald interaction: chi2 = {stat:.2f}, df = {len(interaction_params)}, p = {pv:.3g}")

inter_tab = pd.DataFrame([
    {"term": p, "beta": fit.params[p], "se": fit.bse[p], "p": fit.pvalues[p]}
    for p in interaction_params
]).sort_values("p")
print("\nTop interaction terms by p:")
print(inter_tab.head(8).to_string(index=False))

(CACHE / "lmm_interaction.txt").write_text(
    f"Linear mixed model: Shannon ~ C(compartment) * C(trip) + (1|site)\n"
    f"n = {len(df)} samples; random grouping = site ({df.site_str.nunique()} sites)\n\n"
    f"Omnibus Wald test across {len(interaction_params)} interaction terms:\n"
    f"  chi2 = {stat:.2f}, df = {len(interaction_params)}, p = {pv:.3g}\n\n"
    + inter_tab.to_string(index=False)
)
print("\nwrote", CACHE / "lmm_interaction.txt")
```

## 2. Rhizosphere Shannon × host-plant genus ANOVA

```{python}
#| label: host-anova
plants = pd.read_csv(CACHE / "plants_by_site_trip.tsv", sep="\t").dropna(subset=["scientific_name"])

def genus(name, rank):
    if pd.isna(rank) or rank in ("kingdom", "family", "order"):
        return None
    parts = str(name).split()
    return parts[0] if parts else None
plants["genus"] = plants.apply(lambda r: genus(r.scientific_name, r["rank"]), axis=1)
plants = plants.dropna(subset=["genus"])

plant_sk = (plants.groupby(["site","trip"])["genus"]
                  .agg(lambda s: s.mode().iloc[0])
                  .reset_index())

rhiz = df[df.compartment == "rhizosphere"].copy()
rhiz_plants = rhiz.merge(plant_sk, on=["site","trip"], how="inner")
print(f"rhizosphere samples with a matched host-plant genus: {len(rhiz_plants)}")

# Only keep genera with >= 5 rhizosphere samples
counts = rhiz_plants.genus.value_counts()
keep = counts[counts >= 5].index
tab = rhiz_plants[rhiz_plants.genus.isin(keep)].copy()
print(f"after n>=5/genus filter: {len(tab)} samples, {len(keep)} genera")
print()

groups = [tab[tab.genus == g].Shannon.values for g in keep]
F, p_anova = f_oneway(*groups)
H, p_kw = kruskal(*groups)
print(f"One-way ANOVA: F({len(keep)-1}, {len(tab)-len(keep)}) = {F:.2f}, p = {p_anova:.3g}")
print(f"Kruskal–Wallis: H({len(keep)-1}) = {H:.2f}, p = {p_kw:.3g}")

(CACHE / "rhiz_shannon_anova.txt").write_text(
    f"ANOVA: Rhizosphere Shannon ~ host-plant genus\n"
    f"  {len(keep)} genera with n ≥ 5 rhizosphere samples each (total n = {len(tab)})\n"
    f"  F({len(keep)-1}, {len(tab)-len(keep)}) = {F:.2f}, p = {p_anova:.3g}\n"
    f"  Kruskal–Wallis: H = {H:.2f}, p = {p_kw:.3g}\n"
)

per_genus = tab.groupby("genus")["Shannon"].agg(["count","mean","std"]).sort_values("mean", ascending=False)
print("\nMean Shannon per host genus (n ≥ 5):")
print(per_genus)
```
